advanced-filter-description: Hueyi tlachipahualiztli mitzcahuilia xictlahcuilo ce tlahtolli tlen quipia inin tequitiltin: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ce cahcahualli quinxeloa tequitiltin. Huel tiquinchipahuas mochi monemac tlaltin ica intocayo ihuan impatiuh. Machiyotl: Field1 == Value1. Tlanonotzaliztli: Intla tlaltin noso patiuhtin quipiah cahcahualli, xiquintzacuati ica zan ce tlahtolmachiyotl. Machiyotl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Inic ticpanos zan ce tlanahuatilmachiotl (' \/), huel tictequihuis \. Machiyotl: Field1 == I\'m. Noihqui huel ticnelos miyac tlamantli. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mochipa mochi tequitiltin mocaquih itech opochtli hasta yecma. Huel ticpatlas tlatecpanaliztli ica tiquintlalis tlatzacuatin. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Noihqui huel tictemos tlahtoltlaltin ica regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

Columns mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tasks mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-deck: Xicpepecho ce NextCloud Deck huapalli JSON (ce huapalli ica "stacks", sesen stack quipia "cards"). Stacks mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan cards mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Xicpepecho ce OpenProject work-packages nechicoliztli JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan work packages mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-issues: Xicpepecho ce __sourceName__ ahcuallotl JSON tlatecpanalli (__endpoint__). Ahcuallotin mocuepah amatlapaltin tlatecpanaltin ipan Open / Closed tocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-asana: Xicpepecho ce Asana tequitl tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "data": [...] } itech Asana tlaquixtilli noso GET /tasks). Tequitl monechicoa ipan secciones (memberships); tequitl tlamic yauh Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Xicpepecho ce ZenKit tocatlahtolli tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan items mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Xitlali ce markdown tequitl tlanechicolli (in nescayotl tlen tequitl markdown-kanban iuhqui Obsidian Kanban quitequitiltia): "## Tlanechicolli itoca" tlahtolpani, ihuan "- [ ]"/"- [x]" tlamantli tlatzintlan. Tlahtolpani mocuepa tlanechicolli ihuan tlamantli mocuepa amamachiotl.
import-board-instruction-leo: Paste a Leo outline (.leo file). Top-level nodes become lists, their children become cards with the node body as the description, and deeper nodes become checklists. Marked nodes import as done.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ipan moTrello huapalli, xiyauh 'Menu', niman 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ihuan xiccopina tlahtolli monextic.
import-board-instruction-csv: Xicpepecho moComma Separated Values (CSV) / Tab Separated Values (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Xicpepecho JSON itech Jira Cloud REST API ahcuallotl temoliztli (GET /rest/api/2/search), noso ce namictih { "issues": [...] } tlamantli. Jira statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan issues mocuepah amatlapaltin. Huel ticaquitis ce "automationRules" tlatecpanalli inic tiquincalaquis nahuatiltin.
import-board-instruction-excel: Xicpehpena ce WeKan-machiyotl .xlsx tlapoualtlacuilolli (san se columnas quemeh Excel tlaquixtilli: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Achto fila cah tlacpac tocayotl.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - campa *<field>* cah ce itech `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noso `__predicate_member__`. Xiclalili `-` iixpan *<field>* inic tictemos amo oncayotl ipan inon tlalli (machiyotl `has:-due` quitemoa amatlapaltin amo tlamiliztonalli).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - campa *<sort-name>* cah ce itech `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noso `__predicate_modified__`. Inic tictecpanas temoc, xiclalili `-` iixpan tlatecpanaliztocayotl.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - campa *<n>* cah ce positivo tlapoualli tlen quimati amatlapaltin tlapoualli tlanextililo ipan sesen amatl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tequitiltin san se monepanoah ica *OR*. Amatlapaltin namictih ica ce tlamantli mocuepah.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` quincuepaz amatlapaltin ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked* noso *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tequitiltin iyoca monepanoah ica *AND*. Zan amatlapaltin namictih ica mochi iyoca tlamantli mocuepah. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` quincuepa zan amatlapaltin ipan tocatlahtolli *Available* ica machiotl *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Tonaltin huel motlaliah quemeh positivo noso negativo tlapoualli, noso ica `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noso `__predicate_year__` para axcan cahuitl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tlahtol temoliztin amo quixeloah hueyi ihuan tzinco tlahtolli.

Inin quinextia intla mijcueniliztli cuali otlan ihuan quexquich tlalpan tlacoyan oc quitequitiah huehcauh raw MongoDB tlanamactin ihtec grain, ihuan mitzmacah ticpoloz raw tlanamactin ic ticcahuaz tlacoyan.

disable-all-export-description: Ihcuac tequiti, mochtin quixtiliztli tlatequipanoliztin moquetzah: huapalli quixtiliztli quen WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, noso itech NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ihuan ce tlanamictilli quixtiliztli. Tocameh ihuan occe tlahtolli oc mocalaquia; zan ixiptlatzinmeh mopanahuiah. Achto amo tequiti.

backup-description: Xicpiya Tlanamictiltin, Ixiptlatzinmeh ihuan/noso Tlahtolli (mochtin tlahtolli nechicoliztin ahmo tlanamictiltin noso ixiptlatzinmeh). In .zip melahuac motitlani itech omopehpen tlapiyalizcalli — amo cahuitl tlanamactli — quen backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, quipia YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ihuan /data. Mixtli tlapiyalizcaltin (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) quitequitiah tlaahxitiliztin itech intlapiyaliz tlapaltin.
backup-scope-description: Mochi tequitiloyan, noso ce Nechicoliztli. Ce Nechicoliztli itlapiyaliz quipia ihuapaltin ihuan mochi ipan, noihqui in huapaltin intlanamictiltin — yece amo tlacatl tlapohualtin ihuan amo tequitiloyan tlaahxitiliztin, ica mochtin Nechicoliztin quimomachtiyah. gcs-permissions-note: Xicmaca WeKan itlatequipan tlapohualiz amoxtiliztli/ihcuiloliztli ipan comitl: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → mocomitl → Permissions → Grant access. Ipan “New principals”, xictlali tlatequipan tlapohualiztli correo — “client_email” ipatiuh itech moJSON tepoztlatzquiliz — niman xicpehpena “Storage Object Admin” tequitl ihuan Save.

s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → mocomitl itoca (noso Create bucket → Bucket name).

azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → motlapohualiz → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.

scrum-edit-sprint: Create or edit a planned sprint
scrum-select-sprint: Select a sprint to view its report.
scrum-backlog-help: Order work by backlog rank. Assign cards to a planned or active sprint.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: No closed sprint snapshot is available.
scrum-report-help: Reports retain estimates from sprint snapshots. Unknown estimates are counted separately; they are not zero estimates. Compare velocity only across matching estimate units and policies.
scrum-confirm-close: Close this sprint and save its results? Unfinished cards will move to the selected destination.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Cancel this sprint? Its cards retain their membership until reassigned.
scrum-partial-report: Partial report: only cards currently assigned to you are included.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: A source reference could not be restored: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: This sprint contains only part of the original snapshot.
scrum-daily-observations-help: Each bar shows the first recorded observation of a UTC day, at the timestamp shown. Missing days are omitted. These observations do not record every change or show end-of-day totals. Unknown estimates are not zero. Use this section's Export action for daily observations; the toolbar Export action exports sprint results.
scrum-daily-truncated: Only the most recent 366 observations are shown.
scrum-daily-empty: No daily observations have been recorded for this sprint.
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: First recorded observation of each UTC day; missing days are omitted. Observations do not record every change or end-of-day totals. Unknown estimates are not zero.
scrum-import-pending: The Scrum import is incomplete. Scrum edits and report exports are unavailable.
sync-conflict-hint: Choose a value for each conflict. Sync retries after each choice. Nothing is sent to the source system.
sync-conflict-refresh: Run Sync again to review the current values.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Your assigned cards have been reviewed. No field conflicts remain. Full-list Sync was not run.
sync-conflict-detach: Keep duplicate as a local card
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Remove only this duplicate’s Sync mapping. Its content stays in WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: The source item is gone, but active subcards prevent archival. Keep this card locally by removing its Sync mapping. Subcards are not changed.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Keep the previous card unchanged and create a new Sync card in this list. Retries reuse the replacement.
sync-preview-saved: Based on saved settings. Sync now fetches and checks the source again.
sync-preview-unavailable: Save a Sync source before requesting a preview.
sync-preview-blocked: Resolve the conflicts below before reviewing the change plan.
sync-preview-scope: Counts refer to normalized source fields. Additional data may be omitted by the source parser.
sync-source-scope: Paths group field occurrences across source items. Unmapped objects are reported as a whole; their values are not shown.
sync-source-converted: Converted to text or another representation
sync-source-fallback: Alternate value not used by the parser
sync-source-truncated: The report is limited to 100 paths and shortened field names.
sync-source-omitted: Additional occurrences outside the displayed paths
sync-report-retention: Latest 20 runs. Reports are retained for 30 days.
sync-report-partial: Failed or unfinished runs may have changed some cards. These reports do not resume or undo a run.
sync-report-unfinished: In progress or interrupted; outcome not recorded
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Completed with omitted or converted fields
sync-report-unavailable: Run reports require full-list write access and an available server.
sync-recovery-description: Retained Sync reports from the last 30 days. Search by board or list ID. An unfinished outcome may still be running or interrupted. Refresh to check again; these reports cannot resume or undo changes.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Unable to read Sync diagnostics. Check administrator access and server availability.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Select a numeric field with a Jira field ID and estimate unit, as created by a mapped Jira import. Local changes are reviewed as conflicts. Missing source values are ignored; an explicit null clears the mapped value.
email-recovery-description: One row per recipient. Search by user ID. Message content and recipient email fields are omitted. Pause holds existing and future messages; Resume retries queued messages now. Cancel removes messages queued up to the request time. If sending is busy, retry shortly. A message already being sent cannot be recalled, and uncertain delivery may be repeated. Permanent failures and exhausted retry limits remain available for review. Retry failed messages starts a new attempt cycle and respects an existing pause.
email-recovery-empty: No queued messages or paused recipients.
email-recovery-unavailable: Unable to read the email queue. Check administrator access and server availability.
email-recovery-busy: A delivery or another queue operation is in progress. Refresh and retry shortly.
email-recovery-failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Refresh the queue and retry the same action if needed.
email-recovery-superseded: A newer operator action has replaced this request. The current queue status is shown.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Cancel all currently queued messages for this recipient? Their contents will be removed and cannot be restored. New messages created after this request are kept.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed; review before retrying
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Delivery receipt could not be saved
sync-time-estimate-hint: Time estimates use the numeric original/remaining time fields created by Jira import. Exactly one matching field must exist on this board. Local edits are reviewed as conflicts; missing source values are ignored and explicit null clears the value.
activity-recovery-description: Unfinished notifications are retried automatically. Review missing or changed activities before retrying. Retrying never recreates an activity.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Could not load pending activity notifications.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Plan and pending activity do not match
activity-recovery-busy: Another worker is handling this notification. Refresh and try again.
activity-recovery-denied: Recipient access or notification preferences no longer permit delivery.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: The original activity is missing or has changed. Nothing was recreated.
activity-recovery-failed: Could not complete notification delivery. Pending work has been retained.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: This notification changed since it was loaded. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Could not confirm the delivery setting. Refresh and review its current state.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Permanently cancel remaining delivery for this activity? This cannot be resumed. Already queued email and delivered notifications are not recalled.
rule-email-recovery-description: Review recorded rule email attempts. Unconfirmed attempts may still be sending or may have been interrupted. This report does not retry or cancel delivery.
rule-email-recovery-empty: No rule email attempts match this search.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Could not load rule email attempts. Refresh to try again.
saml-login-not-started: This SAML sign-in was not started in this browser tab. Please sign in again.
history-request-pending-undo: Your last undo has not been confirmed by the server yet.
history-request-pending-redo: Your last redo has not been confirmed by the server yet.
history-request-hint: Trying again repeats the same request, so it can never take back a second change.
